verdict.rationale: A probe confirms ADP serves an llms.txt at its site origin (HTTP 200, text/plain, 'ADP LLM DATA FILE') that explicitly references RUN, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, it appears to be a company and marketing routing file, not product or API documentation. The developer docs origin serves a client-rendered shell to keyless fetches, so it is not agent-readable. missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented docs covering RUN features and API Central usage, machine-readable developer docs at developers.adp.com, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Route small-business payroll shoppers straight to RUN-powered offerings.
